settings.heading: Caution & storage
settings.content:
Caution: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, rinse thoroughly with water. Discontinue use if irritation occurs. Keep out of reach of children. Do a patch test before first use.

Storage: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Close the cap tightly after use.

settings.heading: Returns & replacements
settings.content: 48-Hour Free Replacement: In the rare case of transit damage, leakage or a broken seal, email our care team with an unboxing photo within 48 hours and we will send a fresh pack.

settings.heading: Common questions
settings.content:
Q: Is it suitable for all hair and skin types?
A: Yes. Our formulas are gentle and made for everyday use across hair and skin types. If you have very sensitive skin, patch test first.

Q: How soon will I see results?
A: Your scalp and skin need time. Most people notice a fresher, more comfortable feel straight away; use consistently for 6–8 weeks for visible results.

Q: Can I use the products together?
A: Yes. For hair, cleanse with the Shampoo, then use the Serum or Scalp Mist. For skin, mist with the Face Mist and follow with the Daily Glow Moisturiser.
